parents.subject: Media and Cinema Studies
parents.course: Animated Media from Mickey to GIFs

ns2:section.sectionText: Students who have completed MACS 295 History of Animated Media (SP 60386) should not register for MACS 284. While the number is different, the course content is the same. Registering for the new course would be seen as duplicate credit. Duplicate credit does not count toward graduation and students registering for the duplicate course will be asked to drop.
